creators.name: Emanuele Arielli
creators.role: Professor of Aesthetics, Iuav University of Venice
creators.bio: Italian philosopher working across aesthetics, cognitive science and the psychology of art, with recent work on AI authorship and taste.
creators.why: He brings philosophical aesthetics to the question of whether machines can be authors and whose taste generative AI is aligned to.
creators.role_zh: 威尼斯建筑大学（Iuav）美学教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利哲学家，研究横跨美学、认知科学与艺术心理学，近年关注 AI 的作者身份与审美趣味。
creators.why_zh: 他把哲学美学带进这些问题：机器能否成为作者，生成式 AI 又在向谁的品味看齐。

works.title: Artificial Aesthetics: Generative AI, Art and Visual Media
works.description: A free book in nine chapters, released online between 2021 and 2024 and compiled in 2025, on how generative AI changes ideas of authorship, creativity, perception and taste; it is now being translated into Spanish, Italian, Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
works.description_zh: 一本分九章的免费著作，2021 至 2024 年陆续在网上发布，2025 年合编成书，讨论生成式 AI 如何改变我们对作者、创造力、感知与品味的理解；西班牙语、意大利语、中文、日语与韩语译本陆续出版。
works.idea_en: Generative AI is not a tool added to art but a new medium that rewrites who counts as an author and whose taste the machine learns.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AI 不是加进艺术里的一件工具，而是一种新媒介：它改写了谁算作者，也决定了机器学会的是谁的品味。
works.method: Alternating single-author chapters: Arielli writes from aesthetics, philosophy and the psychology of art (techno-animism and the Pygmalion effect, the artificial gaze, aesthetic alignment); Manovich from media history and his own practice with image generators.
works.method_zh: 两位作者轮流执笔：Arielli 从美学、艺术哲学与艺术心理学出发（技术泛灵论与皮格马利翁效应、人工凝视、审美对齐）；Manovich 从媒介史和他自己使用图像生成器的创作经验出发。
